title: Languages computed with strict size bound
statement: A language $L$ over the Boolean alphabet belongs to the strict size class for a function $T:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ if there is a family of Boolean circuits such that the circuit at input length $0$ has fan-in at most two, every circuit at positive input length is strict, each circuit at input length $n$ has size at most $T(n)$, and the family computes exactly $L$.
hypotheses_covered: The zero-input circuit has fan-in at most two
For every $n$, circuit size is at most $T(n)$
